_readme: PREVIEW CONTENT — 33 provisional image-backed listings. Photos are reference images, not verified Aayam product photography. Names and visual descriptions are draft interpretations. Prices, weights, variants, sizes, specifications and care remain sample data and must be verified or replaced before live-domain release.

products.name: Kavi Diagonal Inlay Band
